{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Coruscant''' (display name '''Premiere - Coruscant''') is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Coruscant]].

It does '''not''' include [[Theed Palace]], [[Reflections III]], or Players Committee Virtual Sets.
